test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The gardener has watered the bushes.

options.text: The bushes have been watered by the gardener.
The bushes are being watered by the gardener.
The bushes were being watered by the gardener.
The bushes has been watered by the gardener.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'The bushes have been watered by the gardener.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the **present perfect tense.**
 
• In **passive voice, **the present perfect tense is** formed by**: "has/have been + past participle of the main verb".
 
• The** structure of the passive voice **in the present perfect tense is: Object + has/have been + past participle + by + subject

Therefore the **correct sentence** is: *The bushes have been watered by the gardener.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **other options**:

 
 
• "The bushes are being watered by the gardener." This sentence is in the** present continuous tense**, which is not the correct tense.
 
• "The bushes were being watered by the gardener." This sentence is in the **past continuous tense,** which is also not the correct tense.
 
• "The bushes has been watered by the gardener." This sentence is grammatically incorrect. When the subject is plural (like "bushes"), we should **use "have" instead of "has".**
